note_circles: CORRECTED 2026-08-02. The 6.56e6 circles were re-digitized with the digitize_stock_fig14c.py template-overlay engine (config FIG15A_XCHECK in repro/cfd/digitize_stock_fig17a.py), which carries +-0.0025 x/L / +-0.4 deg against the +-0.005 / +-1.5 deg of the original blob-detect pass. Two real defects were fixed: the leeward-most circle was 0.2557/153.0 and is 0.3095/164.90 (this reproduces the independent pass-40 re-read and settles the open item this note previously carried), and the 35.6 deg point was mislocated and is 40.39 deg. The other three moved <=1.4 deg and <=0.002 x/L. The 1.52e6 squares of this file were re-checked by the same engine and are sound (<=0.9 deg, <=0.0017 x/L) -- they are UNCHANGED. Cross-figure comparisons against the Ref-50 (ONERA F1) figures carry a further ~0.005 x/L ladder systematic; see stock2006_fig17a_digitized.json.

stock_computed_separation_line.note: Stock's computed free-vortex-layer separation line (legend style '- - - -' (short dashes) in Fig 15a; his 3D BL code), polyline read at ~14 points, +-0.01 x/L

note_cp_legends: Stock's Figs 2 and 3 Cp-station legends disagree at the 4th decimal for three taps (Fig2: -0.03780/0.21220/0.46180; Fig3: -0.03760/0.21240/0.46160); we follow Fig 3. Not a digitization error.
